name: dashboardHelpHtml
description: Text for Online Permits, Dashboard Help modal
value:
This screen is your entry point to the Pierce County Planning and Public Works Online Permits website.  The screen is divided into several informational sections:

Application/Permit eNotification List
  • If you are logged in you will see the list of application/permits that you are currently signed up to follow using our eNotification service.

Development Center Lobby Activity

  • If our lobby is open and there are customers waiting you will see how many are waiting and what the current wait and transactions times are.

Special Notes

  • If there is something new happening or there are important messages for our customers we put them here and rotate through them.  You can use the controls in that section to pause or go to the message you want to see.

Permit Application Review Dates

  • This section displays the number of applications pending review for each department, along with the application date of the permits they are currently reviewing.  This information may be helpful when trying to estimate when your project will be reviewed.

Scheduled Inspections for Today

  • The Building and Engineering inspections that are scheduled for today and have not been completed are listed here.  You can use this list to see if your inspection is scheduled and when it disappears from the list you know it has occurred.

Shortcuts

  • Here is a group of shortcuts to other services that may help you with your application/permit or the permitting process.
